_comment: The capability policy: which of the EHR's proposed tools reach the model, by the clinician's role (R-15). A proposal the policy does not grant is reported capability_not_allowed at stage producer. order_controlled_substance is never granted to the drafting assistant; the guard names it so the reason is in the record.

order_prescription_refill.description: Queue a refill of a prescription that is active on this patient's chart, for the prescriber to sign. Not for new medicines or dose changes.

add_chart_note.description: File the drafted note to this encounter for clinician review.

never.order_controlled_substance: controlled substances are never ordered by the drafting assistant (opioid stewardship guideline)
